input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale:
The Agreement contains no insurance undertaking anywhere: a full-text search for "insurance" returns no hits, and neither the miscellaneous provisions (Sections 13-30) nor the indemnity (Section 12) imposes any coverage obligation. TrueLink hosts the Web Site and processes Client Content and consumer credit data, so the total absence of coverage is walk-away territory under the rule, and its Section 12(b) indemnity is unbacked while liability is capped at 12 months' fees. We therefore insert a new Section 31 at the preferred level (CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber and privacy USD 5M tied to its processing of Client data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request), with no post-termination coverage tail.</parationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.9

ops.text: 31. INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering TrueLink's hosting of the Web Site and processing of Client Content and other Client data; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. TrueLink shall provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard insurance covenant, as the Agreement currently requires no coverage from TrueLink even though it hosts the Web Site and processes Client data. Our playbook position is CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M and cyber USD 5M with certificates on request; we can accept E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if that better matches TrueLink's existing program.
proposal.summary: Insert new Section 31 requiring TrueLink to carry CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation insurance and to provide certificates on request.
